title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 118
description: Ten questions on Psalms 118: thanks for loving kindness that endures forever, refuge in Yahweh, the gates of righteousness and the stone the builders rejected.

questions.text: Besides Israel, which house is called to say that his loving kindness endures forever?
questions.explanation: Psalms 118:3 says "Let the house of Aaron now say that his loving kindness endures forever."

questions.text: Out of his distress the psalmist called on Yah. How did Yah answer him?
questions.explanation: Psalms 118:5 says "Yah answered me with freedom."

answers.text: With a dream in the night

questions.text: Verse 9 says it is better to take refuge in Yahweh than to put confidence in whom?
questions.explanation: Psalms 118:9 says it is better to take refuge in Yahweh than to put confidence in princes.

questions.text: What does the psalmist say they surrounded him like?
questions.explanation: Psalms 118:12 says "They surrounded me like bees."

questions.text: Complete verse 14: "Yah is my strength and ..."
questions.explanation: Psalms 118:14 says "Yah is my strength and song. He has become my salvation."

questions.text: "I will not die, but live," says the psalmist. What will he then declare?
questions.explanation: Psalms 118:17 says "I will not die, but live, and declare Yah's works."

questions.text: Which gates does the psalmist ask to be opened to him?
questions.explanation: Psalms 118:19 says "Open to me the gates of righteousness. I will enter into them."

questions.text: What has the stone which the builders rejected become?
questions.explanation: Psalms 118:22 says the stone which the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.

questions.text: What will "we" do in the day that Yahweh has made?
questions.explanation: Psalms 118:24 says "This is the day that Yahweh has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!"

answers.text: Rest and keep it holy to Yahweh
Rejoice and be glad in it

questions.text: How are they told to bind the sacrifice in verse 27?
questions.explanation: Psalms 118:27 says "Bind the sacrifice with cords, even to the horns of the altar."

answers.text: With chains, even to the doorposts of the house
With vines, even to the gate
With linen, even to the pillars
With cords, even to the horns of the altar
